content.value: <sub>a)</sub> If $K x + y = 2 ; 2 x + 3 y = K$ , then what value of K the system of linear equation has (i) no (15) solution; (ii) unique solution; and (iii) many solutions. If exist, find the unique solution and many solutions corresponding to each suitable numerical value of K.
